newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France software speeds customs clearance.
newsitem.headline: Air France software speeds customs clearance.

text.p: Air France Cargo said it had developed a software tool which would speed up customs clearance operations for freight arriving at U.S. gateways.

"The software we have developed, named LIDO-US, links our global freight reservation system, PELICAN, with AIR-AMS, a system adopted by U.S. customs for air transport," Air France Cargo said in a statement.
LIDO-US enables customs clearance to take place as soon as flights depart for the U.S. as a result of the automatic transmission of information contained in shipments manifests.

"LIDO-US is already in service at New York's airports, JFK and Newark and by the end of the year will be extended to Air France Cargo's other "hubs" in the U.S. - Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, San Francisco and Washington as well as around 100 destinations served from these cities by truck," the airline added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
